system.description: Your Turret's capabilities become: Size Tiny, Initiative +8, Perception +8, Reflex Defense 18 + INT, HP is 15 + LVL, attack equal to BAB + INT + 2, and dealing 3d8 + INT damage. The Turret can be directed by a remote control at a range of 12 squares.
